hypotheses.interpretation: The team whose run defense is better (opponent-adjusted rush success allowed) may be under-rated: run stopping is less visible than points/passing yards, yet it forces long down-and-distance.
hypotheses.name: Rush-defense quality edge -> home ATS residual
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A: +0.83 pts/SD, z +3.45, whole-screen q 0.002, 6/6 seasons

hypotheses.interpretation: Same theme on the production rushing dimension (offense rush efficiency vs run defense).
hypotheses.name: Production rushing net (unconditional) -> home ATS residual
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A: +0.67 pts/SD, z +2.75, q 0.019, 6/6 seasons

hypotheses.interpretation: The more pass-heavy side may be over-rated (passing production is the most visible stat). Pass rate is a descriptive TENDENCY the production adjustment deliberately leaves raw (not a performance statistic).
hypotheses.name: Pass-rate tendency difference -> home ATS residual (negative)
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A: -0.72 pts/SD, z -2.93, q 0.011, 5/6 seasons

hypotheses.interpretation: VISIBILITY: when a STRONG efficiency edge is also visible as a big adjusted points-per-game advantage of the control team's offense, the market prices it fully or over-prices it; when the edge is in efficiency but not yet in scoring, it may be under-priced.
hypotheses.name: Within STRONG CONTROL: control-side scoring-offense advantage -> control-side ATS (negative)
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A within STRONG: -1.31 pts/SD, z -3.03, q 0.008, 6/6 seasons

hypotheses.interpretation: Binary form of CFB-DSC-004: the less-visible half of STRONG CONTROL.
hypotheses.name: STRONG CONTROL with low scoring visibility (control offense ppg-quality edge <= 1.5 SD) -> ATS
hypotheses.screen_evidence: threshold 1.5 = rounded block-A median (1.645) of the oriented feature within STRONG

hypotheses.interpretation: Efficiency that has not (yet) shown up in points may be under-priced by a points-anchored market.
hypotheses.name: Efficiency net minus scoring net -> home ATS residual
hypotheses.screen_evidence: not screened directly; generalises the CFB-DSC-004 visibility idea to every game

hypotheses.interpretation: Totals may over-weight pass-heavy matchups (incompletions stop the clock but also end drives).
hypotheses.name: Combined pass-rate tendency -> total residual (under)
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A: -0.56 pts/SD, z -2.18, q 0.082, 6/6 seasons

hypotheses.interpretation: Among MODERATE edges, the ones carried by success rate (the most stable efficiency stat) may be under-priced.
hypotheses.name: Within MODERATE CONTROL: success-rate matchup net -> control-side ATS
hypotheses.screen_evidence: block A within MODERATE: +1.22 pts/SD, z +2.44, q 0.043, 6/6 seasons
